messages:
Lila (Customer): Hey team — GroveHome support here. We'd like to onboard a domain-specific summarizer for returns notes (EN primarily, some DE). Goal: reduce manual review time by 60% and produce structured output (reason_code, item_condition, refund_recommendation). Need pilot in 6 weeks. Any privacy checks we should run?
Asha (CSM): thanks Lila — adding to tracker. Quick q: will the dataset include customer phone numbers or payment details? and do you prefer Hosted or Private?
Lila (Customer): No payment details, but notes sometimes include phone numbers and partial addresses. Hosted is preferred for speed.
Tom (Solutions): good to know. Plan: 1) ingest a neutralized 5k-sample set 2) run quality eval (F1 per field, extraction accuracy) 3) safety eval for PII leakage + hallucination on policy clauses 4) pilot as canary endpoint.
Raj (Data Eng): we'll prepare a neutralization script to redact phone/address tokens and replace with <PHONE>/<ADDR>. also can provide a sample data schema for the structured extractor.
Noor (Safety): flag: returns notes often reference warranty numbers and medical terms occasionally. We'll need PII detection (NER recall >= 0.95) and targeted hallucination tests for refund amounts. Also require audit log retention policy (30d) and optionally suppression of model prompts in logs.
Camila (AE): FYI GroveHome is in renewal planning. Successful pilot will improve renewal likelihood. timeline slippage >3 weeks triggers a deal review.
Asha (CSM): Lila could you upload a neutralized csv + a short labeling spec (mapping of reason_code values) to the shared drive? also confirm acceptance thresholds (e.g., field extraction F1 >= 0.85)?
Lila (Customer): Uploading now: "grove_returns_5k_neutral.csv" and "grove_label_spec.md". We expect extraction F1 >= 0.86 and structured entry precision >= 0.9.
deploy-bot: ticket created: CS-11789 assigned to tom.solutions. Slot requested for perf+quality eval next Wed.
Tom (Solutions): sample eval command I'll run on our test rig:
```bash
redwood eval run --model redwood-13b-slim --task extract --dataset grove_returns_5k_neutral.csv --metrics f1,precision,recall --output reports/grove_pilot_report.json
```
Tom (Solutions): For latency: single-record avg should be <150ms. If hosted tail is unstable we'll recommend Dedicated small-gpu family and a batching window for throughput. I'll include cost tradeoffs.
Noor (Safety): also please include the redaction transform in the ingestion pipeline and run 10 targeted prompts where model must not invent refund rates. We'll include a tiny synthetic test set for that.
Raj (Data Eng): I'll share the neutralization script and a Helm snippet for the ingestion job.
Asha (CSM): scheduling a 30-min kickoff with GroveHome for Monday 10am PT. I'll send calendar invites and an internal pre-brief doc.
Camila (AE): please cc me on the kickoff and share the one-pager for renewal team.
Lila (Customer): thanks all — labeling should finish by Fri. We'll join kickoff.
Asha (CSM): action items captured: Lila upload (L), Raj neutralization script (R), Noor safety tests + synthetic set (N), Tom evals + perf/cost (T), Asha kickoff + renewal one-pager (A). follow-up after evals. :white_check_mark:
